en.t: We gazed steadily after them as they left.

units.source_text: 一直目送到他们两人走出山门全然看不见踪影了。

en.t: We watched until the two of them had passed through the temple gate and vanished completely from sight.

units.source_text: 对于目送者来说，这段时间是相当漫长的。

en.t: For those who are seeing someone off, that stretch of time feels quite long.
